# Bidyut Innovation - Robotics Education Platform

> Leading robotics company in India providing STREAM education, AI learning, and hands-on robotics solutions for schools, universities, and industries.

## About Us

Bidyut Innovation is a pioneering EdTech and robotics company transforming education through advanced robotics, artificial intelligence, and hands-on STREAM learning programs. We empower students with future-ready skills and provide cutting-edge robotics solutions for educational institutions and industrial applications.

## Our Products

### Educational Robots
- Humanoid Education G1: Interactive STEM learning robot
- Unitree R1: Advanced educational humanoid for coding and AI
- Robot Dog GO2: Multipurpose AI quadruped for education

### Industrial Robots
- Unitree H1: Full-size humanoid for industrial automation
- Unitree H1-2: Advanced industrial robotics platform
- Unitree B2: Smart quadruped for research and industry
- Unitree A2: High-performance quadruped robot dog
- B2-W & A2-W: Autonomous inspection robots

### Collaborative Robots
- Cobot: Lightweight robotic arm for smart automation

## Services

- Robotics Lab Setup for Schools
- Teacher Training Programs
- STREAM Education Curriculum
- Hands-on Workshops
- Drone Programs
- AI and Coding Education
